description:
Cast Saffi Eriksdotter by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi Eriksdotter enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Saffi Eriksdotter, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Saffi Eriksdotter.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saffi Eriksdotter token, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate the Saffi Eriksdotter token by sacrificing it, targeting the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter.
Activate Saffi Eriksdotter by sacrificing it, targeting Cadric.
When the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter dies, the token Saffi Eriksdotter triggers, returning the nontoken Saffi Eriksdotter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
